new_processes.name: Energy market report distribution
new_processes.definition: Forwarding the daily third-party energy market report on power prices, outages and weather to the trading desk.

new_processes.name: Trader roster submission
new_processes.definition: Supplying lists of traders by name to a colleague who needs them for set-up or staffing.

new_processes.name: Counterparty exposure reconciliation
